name: Static Web App
summary: Static Web App for a frontend, SPA or documentation site, with a managed global CDN, optional API functions and an optional Standard-tier private endpoint.
useWhen: You need to host a static frontend, single-page app or documentation site
You want built-in staging environments per pull request
avoidWhen: You need a server-rendered app with a long-running backend process (use App Service or Container Apps)
The site must be fully private from day one on the Free tier (private endpoints need Standard)
